# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old (v1); died several years later  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v4 c2 P1](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011), [v4 c2 P1](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0001)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)</sub>

## Appearance

He was an unusual-looking man with an awkward frame and a stoop to his hunching shoulders. He had lengthy hair that grew increasingly gray over time and a thick, gentle brown beard that he had worn since the age of twenty. He had warm, expressive brown eyes.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c32 P34](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0034), [v1 c36 P26](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0026), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)_

## Personality

Obed was exceptionally quiet, bashful, and timid, deeply disliking crowds or conversing with strangers. He had a profound fear of women and little girls, though he felt comfortable around his sister Thirza and Mrs. Agatha Sowerby. Tender-hearted and sympathetic, he strongly disliked seeing anyone hurt or disappointed. He enjoyed quiet companionship with talkative people who required little input from him.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c2 P74](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0074), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026)_

- To provide a comfortable home and education for Nell  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c6 P32](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0032)</sub>

## History

Obed Abernethy resided at Grey Shutters in Brierley with his sister Thirza. Intending to adopt a young orphan boy to assist with farm work, he traveled to the Alder River station in June, only to discover that an orphan girl, Nell, had been sent by mistake instead. Reluctant to leave her stranded, Obed brought her home and immediately grew fond of her lively conversation, persuading Thirza to let her stay. He formed a warm, affectionate bond with Nell, frequently defending her against punishments and indulging her wishes, including buying her a fashionable new dress for Christmas. Over the following years, he took immense pride in Nell's academic achievements, including her winning the Avery scholarship. As his health declined and financial anxieties mounted over the instability of the local bank holding their savings, Obed collapsed from a sudden heart ailment at his doorway and passed away, being buried shortly after in the Brierley cemetery.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c1 P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P6](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0006), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c3 P55](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0055), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c10 P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 c32 P46](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0046), [v1 c36 P34](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0034), [v1 c36 P41](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0041), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011), [v1 c37 P21](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0021)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Brierley as the son of a timid and quiet farmer who built Grey Shutters away from the main road  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Kept a thick brown beard continuously from the age of twenty  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- Suffered from heart trouble in his later years  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)</sub>
